name: Mustard greens, cooked, boiled, drained, with salt (USDA food medium)
description: Food-derived medium from USDA FoodData Central (SR Legacy): measured amino acids, sugars, fatty acids, vitamins and minerals of Mustard greens, cooked, boiled, drained, with salt, plus a mineral base. Measured nutrients with no curated BiGG exchange are listed under uncovered; non-metabolite aggregates (energy, protein, total fat/fibre) are excluded by design.

provenance.citation: U.S. Department of Agriculture, FoodData Central (SR Legacy), fdc.nal.usda.gov (FDC ID 170503).
provenance.notes: USDA measured nutrients mapped to BiGG via a curated nutrient->exchange table; amounts (per 100 g) in usda_amount/usda_unit. Unmapped measured metabolites kept in uncovered (v2). Aggregates excluded.
provenance.license_name: Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication
provenance.url_status_note: USDA FoodData Central returns HTTP 404 for food-details URLs while its single-page app renders the correct food page client-side (verified 2026-09-06: curl -> 404 with an identical app shell for every id; headless Chromium -> the correct title and nutrient table). The link works for a reader and fails for a link-checker. Do not retire it.

components.name: Octadecenoate (n-C18:1)
components.target_xref_note: these cross-references describe the BiGG id that was chosen; they were not used to choose it and cannot contradict it
components.mapping_note: source name destroyed at build time; it was one of MUFA 18:1 c / MUFA 18:1 and the two collide on this exchange; build_usda_media_v2.py NMAP_RAW; [CLASS-USDA-181] USDA reaches ocdcea only through the class strings "MUFA 18:1 c" and "MUFA 18:1", both of which name a chain-length:unsaturation CLASS covering every C18:1 positional and geometric isomer. The builder replaced the class string with the BiGG display name "Octadecenoate (n-C18:1)", so the rows are invisible to a name-based rule and are matched on method plus id. BiGG resolves six distinct C18:1 species, so the collapse onto oleate is a declared assumption. The two source nutrients also collide on this one exchange, so one measured amount silently overwrote the other.

components.target_xref_note: these cross-references describe the BiGG id that was chosen; they were not used to choose it and cannot contradict it
components.mapping_note: build_usda_media_v2.py MINMAP; [CHEM-SE-01] USDA "Selenium, Se" is a TOTAL ELEMENTAL selenium assay. slnt is selenite, O3Se -- one specific oxyanion. Dietary selenium is predominantly selenomethionine and selenocysteine, not the selenite ion, and selenite has dedicated reductase and sulfur-assimilation routes in many GEMs. The element measurement cannot certify an oxidation state, so this is recorded as a declared species proxy, never as an exact identity. FLUX WARNING for the bounds workstream: 6,468 food media open EX_slnt_e at lower_bound -1000 on the strength of a total-Se number, and selenite is not otherwise supplied by the injected mineral base.

components.name: PUFA 18:2
components.target_xref_note: these cross-references describe the BiGG id that was chosen; they were not used to choose it and cannot contradict it
components.mapping_note: [CLASS-FA-182B] A bare "PUFA 18:2" states chain length and degree of unsaturation only -- no double-bond position, no geometry -- so it covers every C18:2 isomer. lnlc is linoleate (9Z,12Z). The fully specified "PUFA 18:2 n-6 c,c" is excluded by the negative lookahead and stays at its name tier, because there the source string does fix the compound.

components.mapping_note: [CLASS-FA-183B] As CLASS-FA-182B: a bare "PUFA 18:3" covers every C18:3 isomer; lnlnca is alpha-linolenate (9Z,12Z,15Z). "PUFA 18:3 n-3 c,c,c (ALA)" is excluded and keeps its name tier.

components.name: Vitamin A, RAE
components.target_xref_note: these cross-references describe the BiGG id that was chosen; they were not used to choose it and cannot contradict it
components.mapping_note: [CLASS-VITA-01] Vitamin A, IU and "Vitamin A, RAE" are ACTIVITY aggregates: they sum preformed retinol and the provitamin A carotenoids (beta-carotene, alpha-carotene, beta-cryptoxanthin) after applying conversion factors. Mapping the aggregate onto retinol alone assigns one member of the group the whole activity, and a bacterium cannot convert IU into a molar uptake. Declared aggregate proxy. The separately reported "Retinol" nutrient is a specific compound and is deliberately NOT matched by this pattern.

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
